skill.name: artifacts-builder
skill.description: Creates and bundles complex Claude HTML artifacts with React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui components.
skill.summary: Build multi-component Claude artifacts and bundle them into one shareable HTML file.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static matches are benign markdown formatting, quoted command substitutions, project-local file edits, or documentation URLs. The main residual risk is that the skill asks users to run community bash scripts that install npm packages, mutate project files, and extract a bundled archive. No evidence found of prompt injection, credential access, data exfiltration, or malicious network endpoints.

remediation.issue: Unpinned dependency installation from npm registries
remediation.suggestion: Pin all dependency versions, avoid latest, and provide a lockfile or reviewed package manifest for generated projects.
Avoid global installation or require explicit user confirmation before changing the host toolchain.

remediation.issue: Bundled component archive reduces review transparency
remediation.suggestion: Publish the shadcn component files as plain source or include a manifest and checksum for the archive.

remediation.issue: Bundling script removes previous build output
remediation.suggestion: Document the cleanup behavior and keep deletion limited to generated dist and bundle.html paths.

content.value_statement: Complex Claude artifacts can outgrow single-file HTML quickly. This skill creates a React, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui workflow that bundles the result into one shareable HTML artifact.
actual_capabilities: Creates a React 18, TypeScript, and Vite project for artifact development.
Installs Tailwind CSS 3.4.1 and shadcn/ui support dependencies.
Extracts more than 40 shadcn/ui component files into the project.
Configures path aliases, Tailwind theme tokens, and components.json.
Bundles a completed app into one self-contained HTML file with Parcel and html-inline.
limitations: Requires Node.js 18 or newer and access to npm package registries.
Runs shell scripts that install dependencies and modify local project files.
Best suited for complex artifacts, not simple static HTML snippets.
Final bundle size depends on app complexity and selected dependencies.

faq.question: What does this skill create?
faq.answer: It creates a React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, and shadcn/ui project for complex Claude HTML artifacts.

faq.question: Can Codex and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The metadata lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need internet access?
faq.answer: Yes. The setup and bundling scripts install packages from npm registries.

faq.question: Is it useful for simple artifacts?
faq.answer: Usually no. Simple one-file HTML or JSX artifacts do not need this workflow.

faq.question: What should I review before running it?
faq.answer: Review the shell scripts, dependency install commands, and bundled component archive.

faq.question: What output should I expect?
faq.answer: You should get a project directory for development and a bundle.html file for sharing.
